## GLM 5.3 E2EE API

GLM 5.3 E2EE is a large language model by Z.ai, available on the Venice API as `e2ee-glm-5-3-p`. It is end-to-end encrypted. It is also available without end-to-end encryption, as [GLM 5.3](/models/glm-5-3).

GLM 5.3 running in a Trusted Execution Environment (TEE). Z.ai's flagship model with 1M context. Hardware attestation evidence is available for independent verification of enclave identity and configuration.

### GLM 5.3 E2EE API pricing

| Model ID | Variant | Privacy | Price |
|---|---|---|---|
| `e2ee-glm-5-3-p` | E2EE | E2EE | $1.75 / $5.50 per 1M |

### GLM 5.3 E2EE specifications

| Spec | Value |
|---|---|
| Provider | Z.ai |
| Released | Sep 6, 2026 |
| Privacy | E2EE |
| Status | Stable |
| Open weights | Yes |
| Context window | 1M tokens |
| Max output | 32K tokens |
| Reasoning effort | none, low, medium, high |

### How to use the GLM 5.3 E2EE API

Send requests to `POST https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/chat/completions` with `"model": "e2ee-glm-5-3-p"` and your API key.

```bash
curl https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/chat/completions \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $VENICE_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "model": "e2ee-glm-5-3-p",
    "messages": [{ "role": "user", "content": "Explain TEE attestation in two sentences." }],
    "reasoning_effort": "low"
  }'
```
